backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing trending topics, video projects, user accounts/profiles with access control, blob storage mixins, and HTTP outcalls; includes CRUD operations for trending topics (admin-only), video projects, script generation, and user profile management with authorization checks.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module defining all data types (Platform, TrendingTopic, VideoProject, UserAccount, UserProfile, etc.) and a no-op migration function that preserves existing actor state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the Hindi language selection feature for VideoConfigurationPage, listing affected frontend files and components with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files including pages, components, and hooks with descriptions of their functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI elements (background, foreground, primary, secondary, borders, charts, sidebar, etc.).
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script tag loading the React application from main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for landing, trending, templates, editor, configure, export, and account pages; includes AuthGuard for protected routes and ProfileSetupDialog for first-time users.
frontend/src/components/CoinPurchaseDial: Modal dialog component for purchasing coin packages (100, 500, 1000) with selectable cards, current balance display, and purchase mutation integration.
frontend/src/components/ExportProgress.t: Progress bar component displaying video export progress percentage with dynamic status messages based on completion stage.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with header navigation (Trending, Templates, Account), authentication-aware routing, and footer with Caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that toggles between login/logout states, handles Internet Identity authentication flow, and clears query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Modal dialog for new user onboarding that collects name and username, creates user profile with free tier subscription, and initializes user account.
frontend/src/components/SubscriptionCard: Premium subscription upgrade card displaying feature comparison (watermark-free, unlimited renders, HD quality, etc.) with upgrade action button.
frontend/src/components/TimelineTrack.ts: Visual timeline track component that displays items proportionally by duration with color-coded segments and hover effects.
frontend/src/components/TrendingTopicCar: Card component displaying trending topic details including platform badge, hashtags, keywords, engagement metrics (views, likes, shares, comments), and create video action.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that manages backend actor creation with authentication, initializes access control with admin token, and invalidates dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing AuthClient lifecycle, identity state, login/logout flows, and authentication status.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file indicating queries are organized in feature-specific hook files rather than centralized.
frontend/src/hooks/useScriptGeneration.t: React Query mutation hook for generating video scripts based on topic, language, duration, and style parameters via backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTrendingTopics.ts: React Query hooks for fetching trending topics: individual topic by ID, filtered by platform, and sorted by engagement metrics.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserAccount.ts: React Query hooks for managing user account operations including fetching account details, creating accounts, upgrading to premium, and adding coins.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and saving the caller's user profile with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoProject.ts: React Query hooks for fetching individual video projects, listing caller's projects, and updating project status.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoProjectMutati: React Query mutation hook for creating new video projects with title, topic, script, stock videos, music, voiceover, and format parameters.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes, including color schemes, sidebar styling, and Hindi font support via Noto Sans Devanagari.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/ExportPage.tsx: Page for exporting video projects with progress tracking, premium badge display, simulated rendering progress, and download functionality.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page showcasing AI video creation features with hero banner, feature cards highlighting trending topics, AI script generation, and auto video creation.
frontend/src/pages/TemplateLibraryPage.t: Page displaying pre-configured video templates across categories (News, Review, Motivation, etc.) with template selection that navigates to trending topics.
frontend/src/pages/TimelineEditorPage.ts: Timeline editor page component that displays a video project's script, timeline tracks (video clips, music, voiceover, effects), and provides navigation to export. Fetches project data by ID and renders loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/TrendingPage.tsx: Trending topics discovery page with platform-filtered tabs (YouTube, Instagram, X, Google Trends). Displays trending topic cards sorted by engagement and allows users to select topics for video configuration.
frontend/src/pages/UserAccountPage.tsx: User account dashboard displaying subscription tier, coin balance, video project count, and subscription management. Includes coin purchase dialog and lists user's video projects with status badges.
frontend/src/pages/VideoConfigurationPag: Video configuration page for customizing video parameters (language, style, voiceover, format, duration) based on a trending topic. Generates AI scripts and creates video projects with editable script content.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing. Provides sessionStorage persistence for parameters across navigation and methods to clear sensitive data from URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, extended theme settings including container, border radius, fonts (including Hindi support), shadows, and accordion animations. Includes plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state file documenting an AI-powered mobile video creation app for generating short-form social media content with features for trending topic fetching, AI script generation, voiceover, auto-editing, and monetization. Contains known issue: trending topics page not fetching live data from YouTube/Google.
